definitions.explanation: Clothing and other laundry items that have color or pattern, as opposed to plain white items. Used mainly when sorting a wash load.
In a {寄席|よせ} (vaudeville hall) program, any act that is not {落語|らくご} storytelling — magic, comic duo acts, juggling, and the like. Named for the colored ink once used to mark these acts on programs.

notes:
{色物|いろもの} literally means "colored thing." The two senses are unrelated in modern usage but share the same root idea: something distinguished from a plain, unmarked default by color.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色物|いろもの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白物|しろもの}→白物：30774_shiromono⟧: colors and whites
- {色物|いろもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧: washing the colored laundry
- {色物|いろもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧: a variety-act performer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白物|しろもの}→白物：30774_shiromono⟧: whites (laundry) — the direct counterpart of sense 1; also means "white goods" (major appliances), a sense {色物|いろもの} does not share.
